scope: Plain Lean project through verified multi-ecosystem package consumption

exceptions.description: The canonical builder currently expects bridge flake and container files inside the analyzed project root.
exceptions.remediation: Load bridge-owned build infrastructure from the installed CLI while mounting the plain Lean project as the component source.

exceptions.description: The analyzer cannot yet specialize or project generic declarations.
exceptions.remediation: Generate explicit specializations from type use or request only the concrete instantiations that cannot be inferred.

exceptions.description: The analyzer does not connect IO and Task declarations to the existing async Binding IR conventions.
exceptions.remediation: Infer supported effect projections and preserve explicit errors and cancellation in the generated IR.

exceptions.description: The analyzer does not yet infer identity-bearing resource projections from Lean structures.
exceptions.remediation: Infer native class and resource candidates, then fail closed only when ownership remains ambiguous.

exceptions.description: The analyzer cannot choose a host decimal and currency policy from the Money structure alone.
exceptions.remediation: Ask one adapter-policy question and store the answer outside Lean source.

exceptions.description: A callback type does not establish whether the implementation retains the callback after return.
exceptions.remediation: Ask one lifetime question and preserve the answer in generated ownership metadata.

exceptions.description: An undocumented export produces a visible warning while permissive policy allows analysis to continue.
exceptions.remediation: Let release policy set the allowed undocumented-export count.

exceptions.description: A host needs Docker or Nix to execute the reproducible build closure.
exceptions.remediation: Keep Docker as the default, Nix as the fallback, and report one actionable installation command when both are absent.

exceptions.description: External publication requires credentials for each selected registry.
exceptions.remediation: Keep credentials outside generated artifacts and request them only after reproducibility authorization.

exceptions.description: PyPI, Cargo, C, and C++ packaging mechanics exist, but the canonical release does not mark their runtime targets eligible.
exceptions.remediation: Complete real runtime adapters, then enable projections from the same canonical component bytes.

defaults.behavior: Use 0.0.0-local when the project declares no semantic version.
Select Docker when available, then use native Nix as the fallback.
Select every eligible package target when the caller supplies no target flags.
